recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white full-body portrait of a female performer centered within a large, soft-edged circular spotlight, set against a deep black background with bold magenta and white typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by a large circular light source against a dark void
Vibrant magenta display type contrasting with monochrome photography
Symmetrical balance with text anchored at the top and bottom corners
Soft-focus spotlight edges versus sharp, geometric letterforms
coreInvariants: Magenta as the primary accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered vertically, scaled to fit within the diameter of the central spotlight.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white circular spotlight acts as the primary visual anchor and frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold top header, moves down through the central figure, and settles on the tracklist text at the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central circle, creating a dramatic 'stage' effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white circle and black field; high saturation contrast between the magenta text and monochrome image.

letterConstructionRules: Display text features a slight upward arch or 'bulge' effect
Extremely tight kerning with overlapping characters in the main name
Secondary headers use a wide, geometric sans-serif with square proportions
Tracklist text is a condensed, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Main name characters are thickened and slightly distorted to follow a curved path
Dotted line graphic device separates the top two lines of text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy, expressive display type paired with functional, condensed utility type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel for the secondary headers.
Can be used as a base for the heavy, rounded display name if warped and tightened.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white full-body portrait of a 1960s-style female singer in a dark gown, centered inside a large, soft-edged white circular spotlight on a pure black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold magenta display text at the top using a heavy, arched, overlapping sans-serif. Place two columns of small magenta condensed sans-serif text in the bottom left and right corners.

verificationChecks: Is the spotlight perfectly circular with soft edges?
Is the main name text magenta and overlapping?
Are the tracklists positioned in the bottom corners?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and track titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between the white circle and black background.
Ensure the magenta text is legible against the black.
Verify the 'arch' effect on the top text is symmetrical.
Confirm the subject is entirely contained within the spotlight area.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome central subject + Circular spotlight frame + Bold magenta display type + Symmetrical corner text blocks.
